_doc: Closing lines on the look-back screen. 'down' when the debt is lower than at the start, 'up' when it is not.
clerk: The clerk closes your books. "The guild will come back next month."
down: Mbok Sari smiles at the door. "The debt is smaller than when you started. Your parent would be proud."
up: Mbok Sari puts a warm cup in your hands. "The debt grew, but now you know how it grows. That is where change starts."
